mathematicalProof.method: At most n-2 survive: n cannot survive because every initial degree has a departure round. If n-1 survived they must all initially have degree n-1 to avoid rounds through n-2; the sole departing vertex is then adjacent to every survivor and cannot leave before round n-1 either. For n>=3 take an (n-2)-clique joined to two mutually nonadjacent leaves: leaves depart at degree n-2, leaving the clique at already-passed degree n-3. n=1,2 leave nobody.

def dfs(u, fr):
    global al, parent
    for i in al[u]:
        if i != fr:
            parent[i] = u
            dfs(i, u)

def main():
    n, r1, r2 = [int(i) for i in input().split()]
    r1 -= 1
    r2 -= 1
    p = [int(i) for i in input().split()]
    al = [[] for i in range(n)]
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if i >= r1:
            al[i + 1].append(p[i] - 1)
            al[p[i] - 1].append(i + 1)
        else:
            al[i].append(p[i] - 1)
            al[p[i] - 1].append(i)
    parent = [-1] * n
    dfs(r2, -1)
    print(" ".join([str(i + 1) for i in parent if i != -1]))

thread = threading.Thread(target=main)
thread.start()

def find_new_map(n: int, old_capital: int, new_capital: int,
                 old_map: list) -> list:
    """
    Parameters:
    :n (int): number of cities
    :old_capital (int): old capital's number
    :new_capital (int): new capitel's number
    :old_map (list): old road map representation
    :return: new road map representation
    """
    old_map.insert(old_capital - 1, -1)
    next_node = old_map[new_capital - 1]
    prev_node = new_capital
    while prev_node != old_capital:
        old_map[next_node - 1] = prev_node
        prev_node = next_node
        next_node = old_map[prev_node - 1]
    old_map.remove(old_capital)
    return old_map

n, old, new = map(int,input().split())
m = list(map(int,input().split()))

print(" ".join(str(x) for x in find_new_map(n,old,new,m)))
proofs.implementedAlgorithm: Inserts an old-root sentinel, reverses the new-root path in place, then removes the first array value equal to the old capital.
proofs.preciseFault: It reads next_node after overwriting that same parent slot (17 after 15), causing a two-vertex loop on longer paths; even direct paths fail because remove(old_capital) deletes a parent value rather than the new-root indexed entry. The LF witness has a full normal-exit numerically wrong parent list.

mathematicalProof.method: Unique tree paths determine parents. Only edges on the old-root/new-root path reverse; all other parent edges remain unchanged. Follow original parent links from the new root and reverse them, saving the old next link before overwrite.
